description: This Python source file defines the ModelArmorGuardrail class, which integrates with Google Cloud's Model Armor for guardrail features such as pre- and post-call sanitization of prompts and responses. It handles making API requests to Model Armor, processing responses for content blocking and sanitization, and hooks for different stages of the guardrail process, including error handling and streaming support.

classes.name: ModelArmorGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class for integrating Google Cloud's Model Armor, providing sanitization and content blocking for user prompts and model responses, with support for asynchronous hooks and streaming.
